BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

2. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.

3. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)

   D. Keyboard

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

8. When learning Ceilings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for Ceilings.

9. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

11. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
